title: Coffee Moon
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Pieta lives an ordinary life in a city of constant black rain, until one morning her usual conversation with her friend Danae does not happen and she realizes she remembers 'yesterday's today'. Caught in a time loop, she is drawn into a mystery involving powers, a cult, terrorism and memory. A surreal psychological fantasy with a female lead.
life_message: Friendship and the courage to remember and question one's reality matter more than the comfort of routine.
